specific_knowledge.what: Hs reads any composition that drifts over time and reports which carrier is steering the change, when the regime shifts, and whether a change is real or a sensor fault -- the fourth monitoring category (MC-4) that magnitude/threshold instruments miss. This folder holds the public, self-standing studies that demonstrate Hs as an industrial instrument; each is deterministic and hash-chained (auditable, reproducible).
key_results: gas-composition-study: RAN on a transparent O2/CO2/N2 series -- lossless 8.9e-16; CO2 helmsman; 40/60 single-channel-green while composition moved (ratio blindness); see its AI_ASSIST.json
